scope: Read-only source and existing evidence diagnosis; no live calls, services, browser, tests or transactions.

findings.finding: claimTxHash is emitted only for confirmed workflow. Null in the original safe observation does not mean no signed hash was persisted.

Signed journal and submitting workflow precede broadcast. Submission waits for one send/reconciliation and canonical successful receipt (default540s,5s polling); application then independently reads canonical outcome and writes confirmed. Only afterward aggregate records claim and panel refreshes Ready. Current progress therefore precedes final Ready refresh; it cannot establish a refresh stall.
Normal session creates engine without its existing progress callback. Fixed aggregate submit progress cannot distinguish submission acknowledgment, receipt polling, or subsequent outcome read.

workerReadOnlyFollowup.basis: Controls direct report; retained existing packet, no reviewer SDK parsing
workerReadOnlyFollowup.limitation: Block timestamp is not receipt availability or finalization time; send/receipt timestamps were not retained.

assessment: Late canonical completion crossing observation cutoff is consistent with the evidence and default polling/additional canonical reads. It is not proven. No permanent stuck transition or duplicate claim is established; failed automatic acceptance remains failed.
smallestCheck: Use already-authorized exact saved-hash read-only reconciliation/export; verify original operation/payment/three receipt bindings and canonical outcome, preserving original failed run. No second claim or payment. If a future genuine operation needs attribution, reuse fixed engine phases and bounded receipt timestamps, not a new framework.
limits: No timeout increase or acceptance waiver.
No full funding accounting or readiness acceptance asserted by this diagnostic.

subsequentRecoveryPacket.scope: Packet fields inspected, not independent full artifact acceptance review
subsequentRecoveryPacket.conclusion: Existing same-claim read-only recovery reports Ready/export success without new transaction. This supports recoverability, not proof of the original timeout cause or uninterrupted onboarding acceptance.
